summary.zh: 把 Markdown 转成带样式的网页
summary.en: Convert Markdown into styled, WeChat-ready HTML

description.zh: 把 Markdown 渲染成带主题样式的 HTML，兼容公众号排版，支持代码高亮、公式、脚注和提示块。Mermaid 与 PlantUML 图也能一并处理，外链可自动收进文末引用。渲染 Mermaid 需要本机安装 headless Chrome。
description.en: Renders Markdown to themed, WeChat-friendly HTML with code highlighting, math, footnotes and callouts. Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams are supported, and links can move to a footnote list. Mermaid needs headless Chrome.
